answer: Rotating Comet Assignment. Each epoch, a public verifiable-randomness beacon draws a secret permutation of agents to audit; the draw uses a comet-like delayed reveal so no one, including auditors, can precompute targets. Identities failing a randomly assigned audit forfeit a pearl-sized escrow and lose their zenith ranking slot, which requires re-earning from zero. Because assignment is unpredictable, a sybil operator must fund and maintain audits across every plausible identity each epoch, paying full per-identity escrow and audit cost regardless of which are selected.
